title: Flue runtime reliability benchmark — 1.0.0-beta.1 (verified)
description: Standalone evidence-based summary of Flue 1.0.0-beta.1 runtime guarantees, app-owned responsibilities, incident coverage, version caveats, evidence, and recommended next steps.

guarantees_vs_responsibilities.runtime_guarantee: dispatch() admits input and returns a DispatchReceipt (dispatchId, acceptedAt)
guarantees_vs_responsibilities.application_responsibility: Wait/observe final reply via event stream or SDK read()/wait(); ensure dedupe if needed

guarantees_vs_responsibilities.runtime_guarantee: Durable append-only canonical stream per persistent agent instance (Cloudflare DO) with offsets & replay
guarantees_vs_responsibilities.application_responsibility: Use stream offsets for resumption; ensure any external side effects are idempotent and referenced by stream events

guarantees_vs_responsibilities.runtime_guarantee: Interrupted tool calls are recorded as interrupted; runtime will not auto-replay uncertain provider/tool completion
guarantees_vs_responsibilities.application_responsibility: Implement idempotent tool handlers and app-level retries/compensation; inspect SubmissionInterruptedError.meta

guarantees_vs_responsibilities.runtime_guarantee: observe() delivers live-only events (turn_request) synchronously; persisted vs in-process-only fields differ
guarantees_vs_responsibilities.application_responsibility: Design exporters and observers to treat turn_request as non-persistent; read persisted events from durable stream for canonical state

guarantees_vs_responsibilities.runtime_guarantee: Channels verify signatures but are stateless; do not deduplicate deliveries
guarantees_vs_responsibilities.application_responsibility: Deduplicate webhook deliveries and implement idempotency and admission-time dedupe when needed

guarantees_vs_responsibilities.runtime_guarantee: Runtime exposes defaults: maxAttempts=10, timeoutMs=3_600_000, leaseDurationMs=30_000
guarantees_vs_responsibilities.application_responsibility: Tune durability config per workload and test recovery timing under your deployment

incident_coverage.notes: Durable DO-backed streams and state on Cloudflare: solved for persistent agents; Node in-memory queues are non-durable.
dispatch() is admit-only; use streams/SDK to read final completion.
Runtime conservative on uneasy replays; app must manage idempotency and retriggering.
Interrupted tool calls recorded as interrupted; runtime does not auto-replay uncertain external effects.
Channel handlers verify signatures but do not dedupe — app must dedupe by deliveryId when required.

next_steps.action: Deploy a test agent with beta.1 on Cloudflare, force DO restart and observe submission_settled vs submission_interrupted flows; record timings.
Choose to pin to beta.1 or upgrade to latest beta; run SDK integration tests for dispatch/read wait semantics.
Implement idempotent wrappers for external tools and a delivery outbox referencing stream event ids before marking tasks complete.

evidence_list.quote: enqueueDispatch returns receipt (dispatchId, acceptedAt) — dispatch resolves at admission
SubmissionInterruptedError and SubmissionRetryExhaustedError — meta includes interruptedTools and phase
"The channel is stateless and does not deduplicate `update_id` values."

props.content:
This report captures the concrete runtime guarantees and limits observed in the local installed Flue package (node_modules/@flue/runtime v1.0.0-beta.1), clarifies what the runtime enforces vs what the application must implement, records incident coverage (solved/partial/left), and lists actionable next steps with exact source evidence.

Do not treat Flue dispatch() as blocking work; dispatch() admits work and returns a receipt. The runtime is conservative about replaying uncertain tool work — interrupted tool calls are recorded as interrupted and left for app-level remediation.
